title: Spanish fig & almond balls
hookLine: Spanish-inspired spanish fig & almond balls with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Whizz the almonds in a food processor until most are finely chopped, then tip into a large bowl. Roughly chop the figs, then whizz to a smooth sticky paste. Scrape onto the almonds then, using your hands, mix together well with the dried fruit, brandy, honey and cloves. Incorporate {m53163_1}, {m53163_2}, {m53163_3}, and {m53163_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure almonds first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {m53163_5}, {m53163_6}, {m53163_7}, and {m53163_8} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Divide the mixture into 6 and roll into balls. Tip the sesame seeds onto a tray, then roll the balls in them until covered. Cover the tray loosely with a clean tea towel, then leave the fig balls to dry for a week before packaging. Will keep in a cool place for 2 months.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Chill Until Firm, Slice & Store
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover and refrigerate Spanish fig & almond balls until completely firm and sliceable. Portion into 4 servings, add any crisp toppings right before serving, and keep leftovers chilled in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
